legacy.event_note: イベント機能はアプリケーションおよび本番D1から廃止。Wave52 migration 0015で残存event_id列/FKも除去。

notes: Legacy events/event_members are removed from application behavior and migrated production D1; Wave52 also removed stale event_id columns/FKs from affected live tables.
Wave34 notification lifecycle cleanup cancels obsolete pending/retry work instead of hard-deleting it.
Wave43 preserves deleted completion history in deleted_completion_history.
Wave44 closes remaining alternate task-delete paths, recurrence-delete paths, notification hard-delete paths, and deleted-member reactivation paths.
Wave52 removes stale event_id columns and REFERENCES events(id) foreign keys from live D1 tables via migration 0015; application remains task-only.

Wave53 refreshes CSS cache-busting, pins calendar date numbers to the top-left on mobile, compacts shopping list UI with collapsed filters/FAB/detail modal, and adds LINE friend-add guidance to family invitations.

Wave55 auto-discovers LINE Official Account Basic/Premium ID via Messaging API /v2/bot/info when creating invitations, shares the friend-add URL with the invite, hardens recurring-task submission/UI, and upgrades message-to-task conversion to support existing-task attachment or full new-task configuration.
Wave56 fixes recurringForDate D1 binding count, makes recurring delete/toggle work with HTML form fallback, and conditionally reveals recurrence/calendar/time fields to simplify mobile UI.

Wave57 makes recurring-task fields reliably conditional in LINE WebView, gives delete/toggle action-specific notices, fixes timed task date/time layout and multi-day end-time normalization, and applies the same time/calendar visibility rules to task edit and message-to-task forms.

Wave58 fixes inline-JavaScript newline parsing failures that prevented recurring conditional fields and family invite creation in LINE WebView, hardens invite creation feedback/error handling, and refreshes CSS cache-busting.

Wave59 restores XREA-style calendar interaction parity: in-place month navigation/swipe, day-detail left/right navigation across grid boundaries, return-to-selected-date after calendar task creation, clearer day detail completion state, and direct recurrence occurrence IDs for checkbox updates.

Wave60 fixes rendered calendar inline-JavaScript parsing caused by template-literal newline/regex escapes, adds direct touch-event fallback for LINE iOS WebView, and records a prioritized XREA parity/UI/lifecycle residual inventory.

Wave61 restores XREA-style stable multi-day task bands with global lanes, expands day-detail swipe to the whole sheet, adds swipe-follow preview and smoother month/day transitions, and keeps LINE iOS touch fallbacks.

Wave62 restores touch-safe day-detail task reordering, fixes recurrence occurrence exception conversion and linked-child cloning, removes invalid shopping_items.group_key SQL references, replaces prompt-based message editing with a sheet, and adds invitation history/revoke.
Wave64: calendar week height is dynamic by multi-day lanes and visible task rows; show up to 4 single-day tasks; keep date number above multi-day bands.
Wave66: calendar ordinary-task ordering, duplicate shopping add wording cleanup, recurrence exception delete choice, future-only recurrence split, notification lifecycle audit.

Wave67: calendar uses per-date multi-day lane offset; hidden recurring occurrences remain in day detail; excluded occurrence restore UI and split-series lineage added; recurring controller externalized; lifecycle audit extended.
wave63_note: Calendar interaction script moved from rendered inline JS to /public/assets/calendar.js; fixes Wave62 parse regression and enables direct node --check.
wave64_note: Calendar dense-week layout: dynamic per-week height, dedicated date-number zone, up to four single-day task rows and four multi-day lanes before overflow.
wave65_note: Calendar date numbers are hard-pinned to the top-left independently of dense week content; message-to-shopping conversion now uses a full mobile sheet with quantity/category/due/task/assignees/memo/url.
wave67_note: Per-date calendar lane reservation, hidden recurring occurrences retained in day detail, excluded occurrence restore UI, split-series lineage labels, recurring.js extraction, and lifecycle audit cleanup.
